articles.mainIdea: What Catalysts Are Quietly Rewriting The Story For i3 Verticals (IIIV)
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: What Catalysts Are Quietly Rewriting The Story For i3 Verticals (IIIV). i3 Verticals just went through a fresh valuation check, and while the model fair value estimate holds steady at US$34.17, the inputs behind that number tell a more nuanced story. With revenue growth assumptions largely intact and only a small tweak to the discount rate, most of the change in the price target narrative comes back to when certain projects are expected to show up in reported numbers, not a wholesale rethink of the business. Stay tuned to see how you can keep on top of these... Related tickers mentioned: IIIV.

articles.title: Morgan Stanley's Betsy Graseck Previews Bank Earnings
articles.mainIdea: Morgan Stanley's Betsy Graseck Previews Bank Earnings
articles.summary: Bloomberg: Morgan Stanley's Betsy Graseck Previews Bank Earnings. Betsy Graseck, Morgan Stanley global head of banks and diversified finance research, says 2026 bank earnings are largely in line with expectations. She tells Romaine Bostick and Katie Greifeld on "The Close" that estimates should rise as M&A and IPO activity accelerates.
